io.exportDescription: Choose an export range, data format, and destination. JSON lets you set its output structure, BSON type encoding, and indentation separately.
io.importDescription: Choose a file to automatically detect JSON, JSONL / NDJSON, Relaxed / Canonical EJSON, CSV, TSV, Excel, or BSON.

encodingHelp.plain: BSON types such as ObjectId, Date, and Decimal128 become strings or numbers and are not restored automatically when imported again.
encodingHelp.relaxed: The readable MongoDB Extended JSON mode. It preserves special types such as ObjectId and Date, while Int32, Int64, and Double become ordinary JSON numbers without their exact numeric types.
encodingHelp.canonical: The exact MongoDB Extended JSON mode. It uses wrappers such as $oid, $date, $numberInt, and $numberLong to preserve BSON types for lossless re-import, but is more verbose.

layoutHelp.array: Stores all documents in one JSON array, suitable for standard JSON tools that read the data at once.
layoutHelp.jsonl: Writes data line by line, with each line containing one complete JSON object; suitable for streaming and large datasets.

webStorage.modeHint: Choose where connections, saved queries, history, settings and schemas are kept.
webStorage.serverDescription: Data is saved on the server under your account. Connection passwords are encrypted on the server and can be reused across browsers.
webStorage.browserDescription: Data stays in this browser. Connection passwords are not saved and must be entered for every connection. Clearing site data deletes your local data. The server still executes queries and records operation audits.

webStorage.serverPasswordHint: Passwords are encrypted and saved on the server under your account.

connectionTransfer.exportDescription: Transfer saved connection configurations. Only file paths are included; key and certificate files stay on this computer.
connectionTransfer.importDescription: Choose a file, review its connections, then import. Imported connections will not connect automatically.

formatHelp.amdm: Save all selected connection configurations together in AMDM JSON. Passwords are excluded by default.
formatHelp.compass: A bulk JSON file for MongoDB Compass. A passphrase can encrypt the included secrets in the Compass format.
formatHelp.urls: One MongoDB URI per line. Save a file or copy the list.
formatHelp.studio3t: One MongoDB URI per line for Studio 3T URI import; proprietary archives are not included.
formatHelp.nosqlbooster: One MongoDB URI per line for NoSQLBooster URI import; proprietary archives are not included.
formatHelp.robo3t: Save or copy MongoDB URIs, then paste each URI into Robo 3T. This is a URI list, not a native Robo 3T settings file.

connectionTransfer.includeSecrets: Include stored passwords and key passphrases
connectionTransfer.includeDatabasePassword: Include database passwords (SSH credentials are omitted)
connectionTransfer.amdmEncryption: Including secrets requires a passphrase. The entire AMDM file content is encrypted.
connectionTransfer.compassEncryption: With a passphrase, secrets use Compass-compatible encryption. Without one, included passwords are plaintext.
connectionTransfer.plaintextAcknowledgement: I understand that included passwords will be saved or copied in plaintext.
connectionTransfer.copyHelp: Create copies by default. Duplicate names receive a numeric suffix such as “ (2)” or “ (3)”. Select Replace to choose an existing connection explicitly.
connectionTransfer.matchingNamesCopy: Existing connections with this name: {{count}}. A new copy will be created with a numeric suffix such as “ (2)”.
connectionTransfer.replaceHelp: Replacement overwrites the saved configuration. Stored passwords and passphrases missing from the imported connection will be cleared.
connectionTransfer.duplicateReplacement: Each saved connection can be replaced only once per import.
connectionTransfer.acknowledgeWarnings: I have reviewed the warnings for the selected connections and accept the described changes.
connectionTransfer.importSuccess: Imported {{count}} connections. No connections were started.
connectionTransfer.importSummary: Created {{created}} new connections; replaced {{replaced}} existing connections. New connections appear at the end of the list.
